    16	/-!
    17	# The local-presentation contract for the rank-one Picard locus
    18	
    19	An element of `picDegLayerFunctor` is an etale-plus class, not a chosen line bundle.  The
    20	rank-one route therefore needs an explicit local presentation before it can use the evaluation
    21	map of a line bundle.  `PicRankOneLocalPresentation` records that presentation on an affine
    22	test and ties every piece of data to the input class:
    23	
    24	* a descent-class representative whose plus class is the affine collapse of the input;
    25	* a cocycle datum presenting that same relative Picard class;
    26	* a locally free rank-one `Scheme.Modules` object whose base-ring sheaf is the datum's sheaf;
    27	* invertibility of the canonical native pushforward base-change mate on every cartesian square;
    28	* the cohomological rank-one outputs used by the evaluation construction.
    29	
    30	No existence, openness, or representability assertion is made here.  The first canonical
    31	consumer is `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.evaluation`, the pullback-pushforward counit.
    32	The method `PicRankOneLocalPresentation.h0BaseChange` derives arbitrary affine base change
    33	from the same presentation's `H^1`-vanishing field.  The section bridge at the end identifies
    34	datum `H^0` with native global sections and proves, by the adjunction triangle identity, that
    35	the evaluation counit sends the canonical unit-lift back to that same section.
    36	-/

    59	/-- A rank-one presentation of a genus-degree plus class on an affine test.
    60	
    61	The two equality fields prevent an unrelated cocycle datum or line bundle from serving as a
    62	witness: `representative` presents the input plus class, `datum_class` presents that same
    63	relative Picard class, and `module_iso` identifies the resulting cocycle sheaf with the
    64	underlying base-ring sheaf of `module`. -/
    65	structure PicRankOneLocalPresentation
    66	    (lam : picDegLayer C (genus C : ℤ) (overSpec k A)) : Type (u + 1) where
    67	  cover : Algebra.EtaleCover A
    68	  representative : descentClasses C cover
    69	  represents :
    70	    PicEtAff.mk C cover representative = picEtAffineEquiv C A lam.1
    71	  datum : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C cover.Carrier pi
    72	  datum_class :
    73	    (representative : relPic C (overSpec k cover.Carrier)) =
    74	      relPicMk C (overSpec k cover.Carrier) datum.cechPicClass
    75	  module : (relCurve C cover.Carrier).Modules
    76	  module_iso :
    77	    Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
    78	      (Over.mk (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier))) module ≅ datum.sheaf
    79	  line_bundle : Scheme.Modules.IsLineBundle module
    80	  native_pushforward_base_change :
    81	    ∀ {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
    82	      (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
    83	      (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C cover.Carrier)
    84	      (sq : IsPullback g' f'
    85	        (relCurve C cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of cover.Carrier)) g),
    86	      IsIso ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app module)
    87	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 1)
    88	  h0_finite : Module.Finite cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    89	  h0_projective : Module.Projective cover.Carrier (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0)
    90	  h0_rank_one :
    91	    ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum cover.Carrier,
    92	      Module.rankAtStalk (Sheaf.HModule datum.sheaf 0) p = 1

   104	/-- The canonical `H^0` base-change equivalence attached to a rank-one presentation.
   105	
   106	This is derived from `P.h1_vanishing`; it is not an independently chosen witness. -/
   107	noncomputable def h0BaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   108	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   109	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   110	    B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] (Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) ≃ₗ[B]
   111	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=

   113	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing)

   115	/-- The canonical evaluation map attached to a tied local rank-one presentation. -/
   116	noncomputable def evaluation (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   117	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   118	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj

   120	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ⟶

   127	/-- The canonical native pushforward base-change isomorphism supplied by the presentation.
   128	
   129	The isomorphism is not chosen independently: its hom is definitionally
   130	`(canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module`. -/
   131	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   132	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   133	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   134	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   135	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   136	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   137	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g).obj
   138	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   139	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   140	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f').obj ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) := by
   141	  exact @asIso _ _ _ _ ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module)
   142	    (P.native_pushforward_base_change g f' g' sq)
   143	
   144	/-- The native pushforward base-change isomorphism for an affine coefficient extension. -/
   145	noncomputable def nativeBaseChangeIsoAffine (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   146	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   147	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   148	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   149	      (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap P.cover.Carrier B)))).obj
   150	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   151	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   152	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   153	        (relCurve C B ↘ Spec (.of B))).obj
   154	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) :=
   155	  P.nativeBaseChangeIso
   156	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   157	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   158	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   159	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   161	/-- The source of evaluation identifies canonically with the source of evaluation after any
   162	cartesian base change. -/
   163	noncomputable def evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   164	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   165	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   166	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   167	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   168	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   169	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback
   170	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⋙
   171	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj
   172	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   173	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) ≅
   174	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback f').obj
   175	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) :=
   176	  ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   177	    Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   178	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   179	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).app
   180	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   181	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).symm) ≪≫
   182	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').mapIso (P.nativeBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq)
   183	
   184	/-- Under the source identification, evaluation after base change is the pullback of the
   185	presentation's original evaluation counit. -/
   186	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   187	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   188	    {T' X' : Scheme.{u}}
   189	    (g : T' ⟶ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) (f' : X' ⟶ T')
   190	    (g' : X' ⟶ relCurve C P.cover.Carrier)
   191	    (sq : IsPullback g' f'
   192	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) g) :
   193	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso g f' g' sq).hom ≫
   194	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   195	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module) =
   196	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map P.evaluation := by
   197	  change ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
   198	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
   199	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g'
   200	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).symm).inv).app
   201	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   202	            (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)) ≫
   203	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app P.module) ≫
   204	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
   205	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj P.module)) =
   206	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
   207	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   208	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).counit.app P.module)
   209	  exact canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel sq P.module

   211	/-! The affine coefficient-extension spelling of the evaluation/base-change contract.
   212	
   213	This is the consumer-facing specialization for the future zero-locus construction: it keeps
   214	the coefficient ring `B` and `relCurveMap` explicit while retaining the canonical cartesian
   215	square, rather than introducing a second base-change witness. -/
   216	theorem evaluationSourceBaseChangeIsoAffine_hom_evaluation
   217	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   218	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   219	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   220	    (P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso
   221	      (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   222	      (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   223	      (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   224	      (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C
   225	        (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))).hom ≫
   226	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   227	          (snd C (overSpec k B)).left).counit.app
   228	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).obj P.module) =
   229	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)).map P.evaluation := by
   230	  exact P.evaluationSourceBaseChangeIso_hom_evaluation
   231	    (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B).left
   232	    (snd C (overSpec k B)).left
   233	    (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier B)
   234	    (Over.isPullback_whiskerLeft C (overSpecMap (k := k) P.cover.Carrier B))

   238	/-- The global datum section represented by a degree-zero cohomology class. -/
   239	noncomputable def datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   240	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   241	    P.datum.sheaf.obj.obj (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens)) :=

   243	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   244	    isTerminalTop P.datum.sheaf y

   246	/-! The datum-side section after coefficient extension.  This deliberately stops at the
   247	glued cocycle sheaf; identifying it with native `Scheme.Modules` global sections is a
   248	separate contract and is not smuggled in here. -/
   249	noncomputable def datumSectionBaseChange (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   250	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   251	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   252	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   253	    (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf.obj.obj
   254	      (op (⊤ : (relCurve C B).Opens)) :=
   255	  Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   256	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   257	    isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf
   258	    (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y))

   260	/-- H⁰ base change transports the tied datum section to the canonical glued-section map. -/
   261	theorem datumSectionBaseChange_one_tmul (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   262	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   263	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B]
   264	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   265	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y =
   266	      P.datum.sectionsMapTop B (P.datumSection y) := by
   267	  exact P.datum.linearEquiv₀_datumH0BaseChange_one_tmul B
   268	    ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing) y

   270	/-- The conditional divisor datum cut by a base-changed presentation section.
   271	
   272	The explicit `hsec` hypothesis is the non-vacuous fibrewise nonvanishing input.  It is
   273	converted componentwise to the injectivity required by the fibrewise-regular section
   274	construction; the integral fibre instance is installed from the standing geometrically
   275	irreducible curve hypotheses.
   276	-/
   277	noncomputable def sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   278	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   279	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   280	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   281	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   282	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   283	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   284	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
   285	    (relCurve C B).LocalEquations :=
   286	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   287	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   288	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   289	  D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular s
   290	    (fun j q => by
   291	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   292	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   293	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)
   294	
   295	/-- The conditional section construction preserves the base-changed datum's Picard class. -/
   296	theorem sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange_picClass
   297	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   298	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   299	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [IsNoetherianRing B]
   300	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   301	    (hsec : ∀ q : PrimeSpectrum B,
   302	      (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   303	        (P.datumSectionBaseChange B y) ≠ 0) :
   304	    (P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange B y hsec).picClass =
   305	      (P.datum.baseChange B).cechPicClass := by
   306	  let D := P.datum.baseChange B
   307	  let s : ↥(gluedSubmodule B D.pieces D.unit ⊤) :=
   308	    P.datumSectionBaseChange B y
   309	  unfold sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   310	  exact D.sectionLocalEquationsOfFibrewiseRegular_picClass s
   311	    (fun j q => by
   312	      letI : IsIntegral (relCurve C q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   313	        instIsIntegralBaseChange C q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   314	      exact D.injective_rTensor_component_of_sectionsMapTop_ne_zero s q (hsec q) j)

   316	/-- The presentation identifies datum `H^0` with native global sections of its line bundle. -/
   317	noncomputable def moduleSectionsEquiv (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   318	    Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[P.cover.Carrier] Γ(P.module, ⊤) :=
   319	  (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv P.module_iso.symm 0).trans
   320	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   321	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   322	      isTerminalTop
   323	      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   324	        (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module))

   326	/-- The native section is exactly the datum section transported through `module_iso`. -/
   327	theorem module_iso_inv_datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   328	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   329	    (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens))).hom
   330	      (P.datumSection y) = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := by
   331	  exact Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀_naturality
   332	    (hT := isTerminalTop) (f := P.module_iso.inv) y

   334	/-- A datum `H^0` class, read as a global section of the native pushforward. -/
   335	noncomputable def pushforwardSectionOfH0 (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   336	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   337	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   338	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module, ⊤) := by
   339	  change Γ(P.module,
   340	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   341	      (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))
   342	  simpa using P.moduleSectionsEquiv y

   344	/-- The canonical unit-lift of a datum `H^0` class to the source of evaluation. -/
   345	noncomputable def evaluationLiftOfH0 (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   346	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   347	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
   348	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   349	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   350	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module),
   351	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   352	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens)) :=
   353	  ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   354	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).unit.app
   355	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   356	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).app
   357	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens) (P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y)
   358

     9	/-!
    10	# The presentation locus for the rank-one Abel map
    11	
    12	`PicRankOneOpen` is the functorial locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer whose pullback to
    13	every affine test admits a tied `PicRankOneLocalPresentation`.  Quantifying after every affine
    14	pullback makes the condition intrinsic on arbitrary test schemes; stability under further
    15	pullback is exactly `picEtMap_comp`.
    16	
    17	The remaining declarations form the corresponding preimages in the widened divisor functor and
    18	in its canonical representing Yoneda functor, together with the restricted Abel transformations.
    19	These are logical subfunctors only.  In particular, this file does not prove that
    20	`PicRankOneOpen` is represented by an open subscheme, and it reserves `DivRankOneOpen` for the
    21	future actual open subscheme of the divisor representer.
    22	-/
    23	
    24	set_option autoImplicit false
    25	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    26	
    27	universe u
    28	
    29	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    30	
    31	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    32	
    33	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    34	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    35	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    36	variable (pi : C.left ⟶ P1 k) [IsFinite pi]
    37	
    38	noncomputable section
    39	
    40	/-- The rank-one presentation locus in the degree-`genus C` Picard layer.
    41	
    42	Membership means that every affine pullback of the input plus class admits a local presentation
    43	tied to that pullback.  This is the correct logical subfunctor underlying the future open Picard
    44	locus; no openness or representability assertion is part of this definition. -/
    45	def PicRankOneOpen :
    46	    Subfunctor (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) where
    47	  obj T := {lam | ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    48	      (t : overSpec k A ⟶ T.unop),
    49	    Nonempty (PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi
    50	      ((picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)).map t.op lam))}
    51	  map {T T'} f lam hlam A _ _ t := by
    52	    let F := picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)
    53	    have e : F.map t.op (F.map f lam) = F.map (t ≫ f.unop).op lam := by
    54	      apply Subtype.ext
    55	      exact (picEtMap_comp C f.unop t lam.1).symm
    56	    rw [e]
    57	    exact hlam A (t ≫ f.unop)
    58	
    59	/-- The inverse image of `PicRankOneOpen` under the affine widened Abel transformation.
    60	
    61	This name deliberately records only a presentation-theoretic preimage.  It is not the future
    62	open subscheme `DivRankOneOpen`. -/
    63	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff :
    64	    Subfunctor (divFunctorAff C (genus C)) :=
    65	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).preimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    66	
    67	/-- The same presentation preimage on the Yoneda functor of the canonical genus divisor
    68	representer. -/
    69	def divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter :
    70	    Subfunctor (yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C)) :=
    71	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).preimage
    72	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    73	
    74	/-- The affine Abel transformation restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    75	def rankOneAbelAff :
    76	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor ⟶
    77	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    78	  (PicRankOneOpen pi).fromPreimage (abelDivAffTrans C (genus C))
    79	
    80	/-- Restrict the canonical representation isomorphism to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    81	def rankOneRepresenterRestriction :
    82	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    83	      (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).toFunctor :=
    84	  (divRankOnePresentationPreimageAff pi).fromPreimage
    85	    (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C).toIso.hom
    86	
    87	/-- The represented genus Abel map restricted to the rank-one presentation preimage. -/
    88	def rankOneAbelRepresented :
    89	    (divRankOnePresentationPreimageRepresenter pi).toFunctor ⟶
    90	      (PicRankOneOpen pi).toFunctor :=
    91	  rankOneRepresenterRestriction pi ≫ rankOneAbelAff pi
    92	
    93	end
    94	
    95	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivRepAffChallenge
     7	import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AtlasFromDivRep
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Category-correct ambient contract for the rank-one Picard route
    11	
    12	The rank-one locus lives in degree `genus C`, not in `pic0`. This module installs the concrete
    13	ambient maps that the later open-locus restriction must consume:
    14	
    15	* `abelDivAffTrans` maps the widened degree-`n` divisor functor to `picDegLayerFunctor C n`;
    16	* `abelDivAffSigma` extends a represented slice map to the ambient big-site presheaf;
    17	* `abelDivAffGenusSigma` specializes the map using the canonical genus representation.
    18	
    19	The future public `PicRankOneOpen` must therefore be a subfunctor of
    20	`picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C)`, and `DivRankOneOpen` must be an open of
    21	`divRepAffGenusScheme C`. Its `rankOneAbel` is the restriction of
    22	`abelDivAffGenusSigma`, after applying the corresponding Sigma extension. No placeholder locus,
    23	inverse, representability witness, or endgame theorem is postulated here.
    24	-/
    25	
    26	set_option autoImplicit false
    27	set_option maxSynthPendingDepth 3
    28	
    29	universe u
    30	
    31	open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory
    32	
    33	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    34	
    35	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))} {n : ℕ}
    36	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    37	variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    38	
    39	noncomputable section
    40	
    41	variable (C n) in
    42	/-- The widened Abel transformation into the intrinsic degree-`n` Picard layer. -/
    43	def abelDivAffTrans : divFunctorAff C n ⟶ picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ) where
    44	  app T := ↾fun s => ⟨abelDivAff' C n T.unop s, fun K _ _ t => degAt_abelDivAff' s t⟩
    45	  naturality T T' g := by
    46	    ext s
    47	    refine Subtype.ext ?_
    48	    exact (picEtMap_abelDivAff' g.unop s).symm
    49	
    50	@[simp]
    51	lemma abelDivAffTrans_app_coe
    52	    (T : (Over (Spec (.of k)))ᵒᵖ) (s : divFamZarAff C n T.unop) :
    53	    ((abelDivAffTrans C n).app T s).1 = abelDivAff' C n T.unop s :=
    54	  rfl
    55	
    56	variable (C n) in
    57	/-- Extend a represented widened Abel map from the slice over `Spec k` to the big site. -/
    58	def abelDivAffSigma {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    59	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) :
    60	    yoneda.obj D.left ⟶
    61	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (n : ℤ)) :=
    62	  rep.toSigmaExtension ≫ Over.sigmaExtensionNat (abelDivAffTrans C n)
    63	
    64	@[simp]
    65	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_fst {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    66	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    67	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    68	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).1 = x ≫ D.hom :=
    69	  rfl
    70	
    71	@[simp]
    72	lemma abelDivAffSigma_app_coe {D : Over (Spec (.of k))}
    73	    (rep : (divFunctorAff C n).RepresentableBy D) (T : Schemeᵒᵖ)
    74	    (x : T.unop ⟶ D.left) :
    75	    ((abelDivAffSigma C n rep).app T x).2.1 =
    76	      abelDivAff' C n (Over.mk (x ≫ D.hom)) (rep.homEquiv (Over.homMk x rfl)) :=
    77	  rfl
    78	
    79	variable (C) in
    80	/-- The ambient genus-degree Abel map on the canonical represented widened divisor scheme.
    81	
    82	This is the map that the future rank-one divisor open must restrict. It is not itself claimed to
    83	be an open immersion. -/
    84	def abelDivAffGenusSigma :
    85	    yoneda.obj (divRepAffGenusScheme C).left ⟶
    86	      Over.sigmaExtension (Spec (.of k)) (picDegLayerFunctor C (genus C : ℤ)) :=
    87	  abelDivAffSigma C (genus C) (divFunctorAff_genus_representableBy C)
    88	
    89	end
    90	
    91	end AlgebraicGeometry

316	/-- The presentation identifies datum `H^0` with native global sections of its line bundle. -/
   317	noncomputable def moduleSectionsEquiv (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam) :
   318	    Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[P.cover.Carrier] Γ(P.module, ⊤) :=
   319	  (Sheaf.HModule.mapEquiv P.module_iso.symm 0).trans
   320	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   321	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   322	      isTerminalTop
   323	      (Scheme.toModuleKSheafOfModules
   324	        (Over.mk (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))) P.module))
   325	
   326	/-- The native section is exactly the datum section transported through `module_iso`. -/
   327	theorem module_iso_inv_datumSection (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   328	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   329	    (P.module_iso.inv.hom.app (op (⊤ : (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier).Opens))).hom
   330	      (P.datumSection y) = P.moduleSectionsEquiv y := by
   331	  exact Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀_naturality
   332	    (hT := isTerminalTop) (f := P.module_iso.inv) y
   333	
   334	/-- A datum `H^0` class, read as a global section of the native pushforward. -/
   335	noncomputable def pushforwardSectionOfH0 (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   336	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   337	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   338	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module, ⊤) := by
   339	  change Γ(P.module,
   340	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   341	      (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))
   342	  simpa using P.moduleSectionsEquiv y
   343	
   344	/-- The canonical unit-lift of a datum `H^0` class to the source of evaluation. -/
   345	noncomputable def evaluationLiftOfH0 (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   346	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   347	    Γ((Scheme.Modules.pullback
   348	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj
   349	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   350	          (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module),
   351	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   352	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens)) :=
   353	  ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   354	    (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).unit.app
   355	      ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   356	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module)).app
   357	          (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens) (P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y)
   358	
   359	/-- Evaluation of the canonical unit-lift returns the original native global section.
   360	
   361	This is the right triangle identity of pullback-pushforward.  It is the counit compatibility
   362	needed before the section can be used to define a divisor; no zero-locus claim is made here. -/
   363	theorem evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   364	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0) :
   365	    (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   366	      ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   367	        (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   368	      (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   369	  have h := congrArg
   370	    (fun (f : (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   371	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module ⟶
   372	      (Scheme.Modules.pushforward
   373	        (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).obj P.module) =>
   374	      (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app f (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens)).hom
   375	        (P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y))
   376	    ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction
   377	      (relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier))).right_triangle_components
   378	        P.module)
   379	  exact h

   381	/-! ## Local-away generators for the canonical evaluation -/
   382	
   383	/-- Nonvanishing on every residue-field fibre of `D(f)` survives passage from the
   384	corresponding prime of the original ring to the residue field of a prime of `A_f`.
   385	
   386	The residue-field comparison is an isomorphism because localization induces bijective
   387	residue-field maps.  Keeping this as a private module lemma prevents the rank-one
   388	construction from depending on a false definitional transitivity of datum base change. -/
   389	private theorem fibre_tmul_ne_zero_of_away
   390	    {A Q : Type u} [CommRing A] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module A Q]
   391	    (f : A) (y : Q)
   392	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum A, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   393	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   394	        Q ⊗[A] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   395	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   396	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   397	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   398	  let p : PrimeSpectrum A :=
   399	    PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) q
   400	  have hfp : f ∉ p.asIdeal := by
   401	    intro hf
   402	    refine q.isPrime.ne_top (Ideal.eq_top_of_isUnit_mem q.asIdeal
   403	      (Ideal.mem_comap.mp hf) ?_)
   404	    exact IsLocalization.Away.algebraMap_isUnit f
   405	  have hp : ((1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[A] y :
   406	      p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[A] Q) ≠ 0 := by
   407	    have h := (TensorProduct.comm A Q p.asIdeal.ResidueField).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr
   408	      (hy p hfp)
   409	    simpa only [TensorProduct.comm_tmul] using h
   410	  have hcom : p.asIdeal =
   411	      q.asIdeal.comap (algebraMap A (Localization.Away f)) := rfl
   412	  let rho : p.asIdeal.ResidueField →ₐ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   413	    Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ p.asIdeal q.asIdeal
   414	      (Algebra.ofId A (Localization.Away f)) hcom
   415	  have hrho : Function.Bijective rho :=
   416	    (RingHom.surjectiveOnStalks_of_isLocalization (Submonoid.powers f)
   417	      (Localization.Away f)).residueFieldMap_bijective
   418	        p.asIdeal q.asIdeal hcom
   419	  let e : p.asIdeal.ResidueField ≃ₗ[A] q.asIdeal.ResidueField :=
   420	    LinearEquiv.ofBijective rho.toLinearMap hrho
   421	  have he := (e.rTensor Q).map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hp
   422	  simpa only [LinearEquiv.rTensor_tmul, e, LinearEquiv.ofBijective_apply,
   423	    AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, map_one] using he
   424	
   425	/-- Cancelling an iterated scalar extension preserves a nonzero pure tensor. -/
   426	private theorem one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero
   427	    {R S K Q : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Field K]
   428	    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R K] [Algebra S K] [IsScalarTower R S K]
   429	    [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
   430	    (y : Q) (hy : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] y : K ⊗[R] Q) ≠ 0) :
   431	    ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[S] ((1 : S) ⊗ₜ[R] y) :
   432	      K ⊗[S] (S ⊗[R] Q)) ≠ 0 := by
   433	  let e : K ⊗[S] (S ⊗[R] Q) ≃ₗ[K] K ⊗[R] Q :=
   434	    TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange R S K K Q
   435	  rw [← e.map_ne_zero_iff]
   436	  simpa only [e, TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange_tmul,
   437	    one_smul] using hy
   438	
   439	/-- Base change of a linear equivalence preserves nonvanishing of a pure tensor. -/
   440	private theorem one_tmul_linearEquiv_ne_zero
   441	    {R K M N : Type u} [CommRing R] [Field K] [Algebra R K]
   442	    [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [AddCommGroup N] [Module R N]
   443	    (e : M ≃ₗ[R] N) (x : M)
   444	    (hx : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] x : K ⊗[R] M) ≠ 0) :
   445	    ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] e x : K ⊗[R] N) ≠ 0 := by
   446	  let eK := LinearEquiv.baseChange R K M N e
   447	  have h := eK.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hx
   448	  simpa only [eK, LinearEquiv.baseChange_tmul] using h
   449	
   450	omit [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   451	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] in
   452	/-- A nonzero cohomology class on a field fibre gives a nonzero glued section. -/
   453	private theorem sectionsMapTop_ne_zero_of_one_tmul_ne_zero
   454	    {B K : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Field K]
   455	    [Algebra k K] [Algebra B K] [IsScalarTower k B K]
   456	    (D : BasicOpenCocycleDatum C B pi)
   457	    (hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair D).H1)
   458	    (y : Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0)
   459	    (hy : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] y : K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule D.sheaf 0) ≠ 0) :
   460	    D.sectionsMapTop K
   461	      (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   462	        (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   463	        isTerminalTop D.sheaf y) ≠ 0 := by
   464	  let eDatum := D.datumH0BaseChange K hH1
   465	  have hDatum : eDatum ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] y) ≠ 0 :=
   466	    eDatum.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hy
   467	  let eSection := Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   468	    (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C K : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   469	    isTerminalTop (D.baseChange K).sheaf
   470	  have hSection : eSection (eDatum ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] y)) ≠ 0 :=
   471	    eSection.map_ne_zero_iff.mpr hDatum
   472	  rw [← D.linearEquiv₀_datumH0BaseChange_one_tmul K hH1 y]
   473	  exact hSection
   474	
   475	/-- A fibrewise-nonzero section remains nonzero after localizing and extending once more
   476	to a residue field of the localized ring. -/
   477	private theorem away_one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero
   478	    {R Q : Type u} [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup Q] [Module R Q]
   479	    (f : R) (y : Q)
   480	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum R, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   481	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   482	        Q ⊗[R] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   483	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   484	    ((1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ⊗ₜ[Localization.Away f]
   485	      ((1 : Localization.Away f) ⊗ₜ[R] y) :
   486	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[Localization.Away f]
   487	        (Localization.Away f ⊗[R] Q)) ≠ 0 := by
   488	  let B := Localization.Away f
   489	  let K := q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   490	  have hdirect : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[R] y : K ⊗[R] Q) ≠ 0 :=
   491	    fibre_tmul_ne_zero_of_away f y hy q
   492	  exact one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero y hdirect
   493	
   494	/-- Canonical `H⁰` base change preserves the localized pure tensor's nonvanishing. -/
   495	private theorem h0BaseChange_one_tmul_ne_zero
   496	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   497	    (B K : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   498	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   499	    [Algebra B K] [IsScalarTower k B K]
   500	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   501	    (hy : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B] ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) :
   502	      K ⊗[B] (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   503	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)) ≠ 0) :
   504	    ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   505	      (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)) :
   506	      K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) ≠ 0 := by
   507	  let eH0 : B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ≃ₗ[B]
   508	      Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   509	    P.h0BaseChange B
   510	  exact one_tmul_linearEquiv_ne_zero eH0
   511	    ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) hy
   512	
   513	/-- `H¹`-vanishing in a presentation propagates to every coefficient extension. -/
   514	private theorem datumPair_h1_baseChange
   515	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   516	    (B : Type u) [CommRing B] [Algebra k B] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier B]
   517	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier B] :
   518	    Subsingleton (datumPair (P.datum.baseChange B)).H1 :=
   519	  (subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff (P.datum.baseChange B)).mpr
   520	    (P.datum.datum_subsingleton_h1_baseChange B
   521	      ((subsingleton_datumPair_h1_iff P.datum).mpr P.h1_vanishing))
   522	
   523	/-- The local-away generator supplied over the presentation ring gives the exact
   524	fibrewise-nonvanishing hypothesis required by the divisor construction after localizing.
   525	
   526	This is the missing consumer bridge between the finite-projective generator theorem and
   527	`sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange`.  It compares residue fields across the
   528	localization, cancels the iterated tensor product, and then uses the presentation's
   529	canonical `H⁰` base-change equivalence. -/
   530	theorem sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero
   531	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   532	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   533	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   534	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   535	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   536	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   537	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0)
   538	    (q : PrimeSpectrum (Localization.Away f)) :
   539	    (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).sectionsMapTop
   540	      q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   541	      (P.datumSectionBaseChange (Localization.Away f) y) ≠ 0 := by
   542	  let B := Localization.Away f
   543	  let K := q.asIdeal.ResidueField
   544	  have hiter : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   545	      ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y) :
   546	      K ⊗[B] (B ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   547	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)) ≠ 0 :=
   548	    away_one_tmul_one_tmul_ne_zero f y hy q
   549	  have hyB : ((1 : K) ⊗ₜ[B]
   550	      (P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)) :
   551	      K ⊗[B] Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0) ≠ 0 :=
   552	    P.h0BaseChange_one_tmul_ne_zero B K y hiter
   553	  have hH1 : Subsingleton (datumPair (P.datum.baseChange B)).H1 :=
   554	    P.datumPair_h1_baseChange B
   555	  let yB : Sheaf.HModule (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf 0 :=
   556	    P.h0BaseChange B ((1 : B) ⊗ₜ[P.cover.Carrier] y)
   557	  change (P.datum.baseChange B).sectionsMapTop K
   558	    (Sheaf.HModule.linearEquiv₀
   559	      (Opens.grothendieckTopology ((relCurve C B : Scheme.{u}) : TopCat))
   560	      isTerminalTop (P.datum.baseChange B).sheaf yB) ≠ 0
   561	  exact sectionsMapTop_ne_zero_of_one_tmul_ne_zero
   562	    (P.datum.baseChange B) hH1 yB hyB
   563	
   564	/-- A rank-one presentation has a tied local-away evaluation generator.
   565	
   566	The rank-one field of `P` makes every residue-field fibre of its `H⁰` module nontrivial.
   567	The projective-module generator lemma therefore supplies a single basic open `D(f)` and
   568	one datum section `y` which stays nonzero on every residue fibre over that open.  The same
   569	`y` is transported to a native global section and its unit-lift through the evaluation
   570	counit; the final conjunct records that counit identity explicitly so the future
   571	`divisorOfRankOne` construction consumes this witness rather than an unrelated section.
   572	-/
   573	theorem exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator
   574	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   575	    (p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier) :
   576	    ∃ f : P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal ∧
   577	      ∃ y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0,
   578	        (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ q.asIdeal →
   579	          (y ⊗ₜ (1 : q.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   580	            Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   581	              q.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) ∧
   582	        (Scheme.Modules.Hom.app P.evaluation
   583	          ((relCurve C P.cover.Carrier ↘ Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)) ⁻¹ᵁ
   584	            (⊤ : (Spec (.of P.cover.Carrier)).Opens))).hom
   585	          (P.evaluationLiftOfH0 y) = P.pushforwardSectionOfH0 y := by
   586	  let Q := Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0
   587	  letI : Module.Finite P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_finite
   588	  letI : Module.Projective P.cover.Carrier Q := P.h0_projective
   589	  have hfr : Module.finrank p.asIdeal.ResidueField
   590	      (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) = 1 := by
   591	    rw [← Module.rankAtStalk_eq]
   592	    exact P.h0_rank_one p
   593	  haveI : Nontrivial (p.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] Q) :=
   594	    Module.nontrivial_of_finrank_pos (by rw [hfr]; norm_num)
   595	  haveI : Nontrivial (Q ⊗[P.cover.Carrier] p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :=
   596	    (TensorProduct.comm P.cover.Carrier _ _).toEquiv.symm.nontrivial
   597	  obtain ⟨f, hf, y, hy⟩ :=
   598	    Module.exists_fibrewise_tmul_ne_zero_of_projective p (Q := Q)
   599	      (by infer_instance)
   600	  refine ⟨f, hf, y, ?_, ?_⟩
   601	  · simpa only [Q] using hy
   602	  · exact P.evaluation_evaluationLiftOfH0 y
   603	
   604	/-- The fibrewise-regular local equations cut by a tied local-away datum section.
   605	
   606	The nonvanishing proof is derived by
   607	`sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero`; it is not additional witness data.
   608	Together with `exists_baseOpen_evaluation_generator`, this is the immediate local divisor
   609	consumer on the datum side.  Identifying it with the native evaluation zero locus remains
   610	a separate `O`-module base-change contract. -/
   611	noncomputable def baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   612	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   613	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   614	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   615	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   616	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   617	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   618	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   619	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   620	    (relCurve C (Localization.Away f)).LocalEquations :=
   621	  P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange
   622	    (Localization.Away f) y
   623	    (fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q)
   624	
   625	/-- The local equations cut by the tied datum section represent its base-changed
   626	cocycle datum. -/
   627	theorem baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations_picClass
   628	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   629	    [IsNoetherianRing P.cover.Carrier]
   630	    (f : P.cover.Carrier)
   631	    (y : Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0)
   632	    (hy : ∀ p : PrimeSpectrum P.cover.Carrier, f ∉ p.asIdeal →
   633	      (y ⊗ₜ (1 : p.asIdeal.ResidueField) :
   634	        Sheaf.HModule P.datum.sheaf 0 ⊗[P.cover.Carrier]
   635	          p.asIdeal.ResidueField) ≠ 0) :
   636	    (P.baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations f y hy).picClass =
   637	      (P.datum.baseChange (Localization.Away f)).cechPicClass := by
   638	  unfold baseOpenDatumSectionLocalEquations
   639	  exact P.sectionLocalEquationsOfDatumSectionBaseChange_picClass
   640	    (Localization.Away f) y
   641	    (fun q => P.sectionsMapTop_datumSectionBaseChange_away_ne_zero f y hy q)
   642	
   643	/-! ## Degree of the tied datum -/
   644	
   645	/- The high-priority `relCurve.instOver` used by the section bridge and the degree stack's
   646	base-change `Over` instance have the same structure morphism but different instance keys.
   647	Re-key the standard base-change bundle locally before stating the degree theorem. -/
   648	noncomputable local instance (priority := 20000) rankOneDegreeOver
   649	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   650	    (relCurve C L).Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
   651	  instOverBaseChange C L
   652	
   653	noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeSmooth
   654	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   655	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
   656	  instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
   657	
   658	noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeIntegral
   659	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   660	    IsIntegral (relCurve C L) :=
   661	  instIsIntegralBaseChange C L
   662	
   663	noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeQuasiCompact
   664	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   665	    QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (.of L)) :=
   666	  instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
   667	
   668	noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeFiniteH0
   669	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   670	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
   671	  instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
   672	
   673	noncomputable local instance rankOneDegreeFiniteH1
   674	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   675	    Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
   676	  instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
   677	
   678	/-- The cocycle datum tied to a genus-degree presentation has class degree `genus C`
   679	after every field-valued coefficient extension.
   680	
   681	The proof follows the presentation itself: restrict `lam` to its etale-cover carrier,
   682	identify that class with `representative`, rewrite it as the datum's relative Picard class,
   683	and read the defining degree condition of `lam`. -/
   684	theorem datum_classDeg_baseChange
   685	    (P : PicRankOneLocalPresentation pi lam)
   686	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra P.cover.Carrier L]
   687	    [IsScalarTower k P.cover.Carrier L] :
   688	    classDeg L
   689	      (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   690	        P.datum.cechPicClass) = genus C := by
   691	  let iota : A →ₐ[k] P.cover.Carrier :=
   692	    (Algebra.ofId A P.cover.Carrier).restrictScalars k
   693	  let psi : P.cover.Carrier →ₐ[k] L :=
   694	    (Algebra.ofId P.cover.Carrier L).restrictScalars k
   695	  have hcurve :
   696	      relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L =
   697	        (C ◁ Over.overSpecMap psi).left := by
   698	    refine congrArg
   699	      (fun f : overSpec k L ⟶ overSpec k P.cover.Carrier => (C ◁ f).left) ?_
   700	    exact Over.OverMorphism.ext rfl
   701	  have hpresentation :
   702	      picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 =
   703	        relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   704	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)) := by
   705	    exact picEtMap_eq_relPicToPicEt_of_affineRepresentative
   706	      C lam.1 P.cover P.representative P.represents.symm
   707	  calc
   708	    classDeg L
   709	        (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   710	          P.datum.cechPicClass) =
   711	      relPicDeg L
   712	        (relPicMk C (overSpec k L)
   713	          (Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C P.cover.Carrier L)
   714	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) :=
   715	      (relPicDeg_relPicMk L _).symm
   716	    _ = relPicDeg L
   717	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   718	          (relPicMk C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   719	            P.datum.cechPicClass)) := by
   720	      rw [relPicMap_mk, ← hcurve]
   721	      rfl
   722	    _ = relPicDeg L
   723	        (relPicMap C (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   724	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))) := by
   725	      rw [P.datum_class]
   726	    _ = degAt
   727	        (relPicToPicEt C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)
   728	          (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier)))
   729	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) :=
   730	      (degAt_relPicToPicEt
   731	        (P.representative : relPic C (overSpec k P.cover.Carrier))
   732	        (Over.overSpecMap psi)).symm
   733	    _ = degAt (picEtMap C (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1)
   734	        (Over.overSpecMap psi) := by rw [hpresentation]
   735	    _ = degAt lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota) :=
   736	      degAt_picEtMap (Over.overSpecMap iota) lam.1 (Over.overSpecMap psi)
   737	    _ = genus C := lam.2 L (Over.overSpecMap psi ≫ Over.overSpecMap iota)
   738	
   739	end PicRankOneLocalPresentation
   740	
   741	end AlgebraicGeometry

     6	import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModuleKSheaf
     7	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf
     8	
     9	/-!
    10	# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring
    11	
    12	For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
    13	`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
    14	scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
    15	compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
    16	cohomology engine.
    17	-/
    18	
    19	set_option autoImplicit false
    20	
    21	universe u
    22	
    23	open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite
    24	
    25	namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
    26	
    27	variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]
    28	
    29	/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
    30	@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    31	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    32	    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
    33	  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)
    34	
    35	attribute [local instance] moduleKSections
    36	
    37	/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
    38	private noncomputable def smulSection
    39	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    40	    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
    41	  r • x
    42	
    43	/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
    44	noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    45	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    46	    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
    47	  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
    48	  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    49	    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
    50	      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
    51	      map_smul' := fun r x =>
    52	        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
    53	          (congrArg
    54	            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
    55	              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
    56	            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
    57	  map_id U := by
    58	    ext x
    59	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
    60	      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
    61	  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    62	    ext x
    63	    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
    64	      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x
    65	
    66	/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
    67	lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    68	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    69	    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
    70	      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
    71	  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
    72	  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
    73	      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl
    74	
    75	/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
    76	noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    77	    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    78	    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
    79	  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩
    80	
    81	/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
    82	lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    83	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    84	    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    85	    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    86	    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
    87	      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
    88	  rfl
    89	
    90	namespace Modules
    91	
    92	variable {X : Scheme.{u}}
    93	
    94	/-- A scheme module which is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf. -/
    95	def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
    96	  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    97	    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)
    98	
    99	end Modules
   100	
   101	end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
--- pushforward base change ---
     1	/-
     2	Copyright (c) 2026 The AlgebraicJacobian authors. All rights reserved.
     3	Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Canonical pushforward base change for scheme modules
    10	
    11	For a cartesian square of schemes, `canonicalBaseChangeMap` is the Beck--Chevalley mate
    12	
    13	```text
    14	g^* f_* M --> f'_* (g')^* M.
    15	```
    16	
    17	The two coherence theorems identify its pullback followed by the counit with the pullback of
    18	the original counit.  Invertibility is deliberately not asserted here: it is a property of the
    19	module and square, not part of the construction of the canonical map.
    20	-/
    21	
    22	set_option autoImplicit false
    23	
    24	universe u
    25	
    26	open CategoryTheory Limits
    27	
    28	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    29	
    30	/-- The canonical Beck--Chevalley mate for pushforward along a cartesian square. -/
    31	noncomputable def canonicalBaseChangeMap
    32	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    33	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    34	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) :
    35	    Scheme.Modules.pushforward f ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback g ⟶
    36	      Scheme.Modules.pullback g' ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward f' :=
    37	  CategoryTheory.mateEquiv
    38	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f)
    39	    (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f')
    40	    (((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    41	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    42	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom)
    43	
    44	/-- Pulling back the canonical mate and evaluating recovers its defining pullback telescope. -/
    45	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit
    46	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    47	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    48	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    49	    (Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    50	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    51	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M) =
    52	      ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    53	        Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    54	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).hom).app
    55	          ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    56	        (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    57	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    58	  rw [canonicalBaseChangeMap]
    59	  exact CategoryTheory.mateEquiv_counit _ _ _ M
    60	
    61	/-- After cancelling the pullback telescope, the base-changed counit is the pulled-back
    62	original counit. -/
    63	theorem canonicalBaseChangeMap_counit_cancel
    64	    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    65	    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    66	    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (M : X.Modules) :
    67	    ((((Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp f' g) ≪≫
    68	      Scheme.Modules.pullbackCongr sq.w.symm ≪≫
    69	      (Scheme.Modules.pullbackComp g' f).symm).inv).app
    70	        ((Scheme.Modules.pushforward f).obj M)) ≫
    71	      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f').map ((canonicalBaseChangeMap sq).app M) ≫
    72	        (Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f').counit.app
    73	          ((Scheme.Modules.pullback g').obj M)) =
    74	      (Scheme.Modules.pullback g').map
    75	        ((Scheme.Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction f).counit.app M) := by
    76	  erw [canonicalBaseChangeMap_pullback_counit]
    77	  erw [Iso.inv_hom_id_app_assoc]
    78	  rfl
    79	
    80	end AlgebraicGeometry

1	/-

     4	Authors: The AlgebraicJacobian Contributors
     5	-/
     6	import Mathlib
     7	
     8	/-!
     9	# Base change of sections along the projection `C ⊗ Spec A ⟶ C`
    10	
    11	For an object `C` of `Over (Spec k)` (`k` a field), a commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and a
    12	quasi-compact quasi-separated open `V ⊆ C.left`, this file identifies the sections of the
    13	base change `(C ⊗ Spec A).left` over the preimage `V_A := (fst C (Spec A)).left ⁻¹ᵁ V` of
    14	`V` under the first projection with the tensor product of the sections over `V`:
    15	
    16	`Γ(C.left, V) ⊗[k] A ≃+* Γ((C ⊗ overSpec k A).left, V_A)`
    17	
    18	(`AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange`), sending `s ⊗ a` to the product of the two
    19	pullbacks (`sectionsBaseChange_tmul`), compatibly with restriction along `W ≤ V`
    20	(`sectionsBaseChange_naturality`). Here `C ⊗ T` is the cartesian-monoidal product of
    21	`Over (Spec k)`, realized by `Limits.pullback`; the single bridge lemma between the two
    22	languages is `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left`.
    23	
    24	This is brick 1 of the separatedness ledger (design §4.4): one brick, three consumers —
    25	étale separatedness (arbitrary `A`), the dual-numbers tangent engine (`A = k[ε]`), and the
    26	χ-ledger under field extension (`A = K`). Hence the statements are for an arbitrary
    27	commutative `k`-algebra `A`, and `V` is allowed to be any quasi-compact quasi-separated
    28	open (e.g. the intersection of two affines of the curve), not just an affine one.
    29	
    30	## Main declarations
    31	
    32	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPullback_left` — the bridge: for `X T : Over S`, the scheme-level
    33	  square `(fst X T).left, (snd X T).left, X.hom, T.hom` is a pullback.
    34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.overSpec k A` — `Spec A` as an object of `Over (Spec k)`, together with
    35	  the instance `Flat (overSpec k A).hom` (automatic over a field).
    36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsAlgebra` — the `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` by
    37	  restriction of scalars along the structure morphism. Deliberately **not** a global instance
    38	  (house rule, cf. `Scheme.overModule`); consumers activate it with
    39	  `attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra`.
    40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.resAlgHom` — restriction of sections as a `k`-algebra homomorphism.
    41	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_sections_of_isAffineOpen`,
    42	  `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_sections` — the master pushout squares on sections, for
    43	  an arbitrary test object `T` with `T.left` affine (affine `V` needs no flatness; qcqs `V`
    44	  needs `[Flat T.hom]`).
    45	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.isPushout_algebraMap_sections` — the same square with the
    46	  `Γ(Spec k, ⊤)`/`Γ(Spec A, ⊤)` corners replaced by `k` and `A`.
    47	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChangeIso`, `AlgebraicGeometry.Over.sectionsBaseChange`
    48	  — the comparison isomorphism (in `CommRingCat`, resp. as a ring equivalence), with the
    49	  computation rules `sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one`, `sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul`,
    50	  `sectionsBaseChange_tmul` and the restriction-naturality
    51	  `sectionsBaseChange_naturality`.
    52	
    53	## Implementation notes
    54	
    55	The heavy lifting is mathlib's `pushoutSection` API
    56	(`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/Morphisms/Flat.lean`): for a pullback square of schemes the
    57	canonical map `Γ(X, Uₓ) ⊗[Γ(S, Uₛ)] Γ(T, Uₜ) ⟶ Γ(X ×ₛ T, ...)` is an isomorphism for
    58	affine `Uₛ, Uₜ` and qcqs `Uₓ` when `T ⟶ S` is flat — which over a field is automatic.
    59	This file only supplies the Over-category bridge, the corner bookkeeping (`ΓSpecIso`), and
    60	the tensor-product face.
    61	
    62	The `k`-linear faces consumers may need are one line away from `sectionsBaseChange`:
    63	it is `k`-algebra-compatible by `sectionsBaseChange_tmul_one` applied to
    64	`algebraMap k Γ(X.left, V) r` (both sides land in the structure-map image), and
    65	`A`-algebra-compatible by `sectionsBaseChange_one_tmul`.
    66	-/
    67	
    68	set_option autoImplicit false
    69	
    70	universe u
    71	
    72	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory CartesianMonoidalCategory TensorProduct
    73	
    74	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
    75	
    76	section Bridge
    77	
    78	variable {S : Scheme.{u}}
    79	
    80	/-- **The bridge between the Over-category product and Scheme-level pullbacks.** For two
    81	objects `X, T` of `Over S`, the underlying scheme of the cartesian-monoidal product
    82	`(X ⊗ T).left` together with the two projections is the fibre product of `X.hom` and
    83	`T.hom`. This is the single point where `C ⊗ Spec A` is unfolded to `Limits.pullback`;
    84	everything downstream consumes this `IsPullback` datum. -/
    85	theorem Over.isPullback_left (X T : Over S) :
    86	    IsPullback (fst X T).left (snd X T).left X.hom T.hom := by
    87	  simp only [Over.fst_left, Over.snd_left]
    88	  exact IsPullback.of_hasPullback X.hom T.hom
    89	
    90	end Bridge
    91	
    92	section OverSpec
    93	
    94	variable (k : Type u) [CommRing k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A]
    95	
    96	/-- `Spec A` as an object of `Over (Spec k)`, for a commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
    97	noncomputable abbrev overSpec : Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
    98	  Over.mk (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)))
    99	
   100	@[simp]
   101	lemma overSpec_left : (overSpec k A).left = Spec (.of A) := rfl
   102	
   103	@[simp]
   104	lemma overSpec_hom :
   105	    (overSpec k A).hom = Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k A)) := rfl
   106	
   107	/-- The underlying scheme of `overSpec k A` is affine (it is `Spec A`); form usable where
   108	`IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens)` is expected. -/
   109	lemma isAffineOpen_top_overSpec : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : (overSpec k A).left.Opens) :=
   110	  isAffineOpen_top (Spec (.of A))
   111	
   112	/-- Over a field, `Spec A ⟶ Spec k` is flat, for every commutative `k`-algebra `A`. -/
   113	instance flat_overSpec_hom {k : Type u} [Field k] (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Algebra k A] :
   114	    Flat (overSpec k A).hom :=
   115	  Flat.SpecMap_iff.mpr (by
   116	    rw [CommRingCat.hom_ofHom]
   117	    exact RingHom.flat_algebraMap_iff.mpr inferInstance)
   118	
   119	end OverSpec
   120	
   121	section Pushout
   122	
   123	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (X T : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   124	
   125	/-- **Base change of sections, affine opens.** For `X, T` over `Spec k` with `T.left`
   126	affine and an affine open `V ⊆ X.left`, the square of section rings
   127	
   128	```
   129	Γ(Spec k, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
   130	     |               |
   131	     ↓               ↓
   132	Γ(T.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ T).left, fst⁻¹ V)
   133	```
   134	
   135	is a pushout of commutative rings. No flatness is needed in the affine case. -/
   136	theorem Over.isPushout_sections_of_isAffineOpen
   137	    (hT : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : T.left.Opens)) {V : X.left.Opens} (hV : IsAffineOpen V) :
   138	    IsPushout (X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge))
   139	      (T.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge)
   140	      ((fst X T).left.appLE V ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
   141	      ((snd X T).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   142	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X T).left).ge)) := by
   143	  have hUST : (⊤ : T.left.Opens) ≤ T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   144	    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge
   145	  have hUSX : V ≤ X.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   146	    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge
   147	  have hUY : (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V =
   148	      (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (snd X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) := by
   149	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
   150	  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isAffineOpen (Over.isPullback_left X T) hUST hUSX hUY
   151	    (isAffineOpen_top _) hT hV
   152	  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h
   153	
   154	/-- **Base change of sections, qcqs opens.** For `X, T` over `Spec k` with `T.hom` flat,
   155	`T.left` affine, and a quasi-compact quasi-separated open `V ⊆ X.left` (e.g. an
   156	intersection of two affine opens of a separated scheme, or all of a proper curve), the
   157	square of section rings
   158	
   159	```
   160	Γ(Spec k, ⊤) ⟶ Γ(X.left, V)
   161	     |               |
   162	     ↓               ↓
   163	Γ(T.left, ⊤) ⟶ Γ((X ⊗ T).left, fst⁻¹ V)
   164	```
   165	
   166	is a pushout of commutative rings. Flatness of `T.hom` holds automatically for
   167	`T = overSpec k A` (`AlgebraicGeometry.flat_overSpec_hom`). -/
   168	theorem Over.isPushout_sections [Flat T.hom] (hT : IsAffineOpen (⊤ : T.left.Opens))
   169	    {V : X.left.Opens} (hV : IsCompact (V : Set X.left))
   170	    (hV' : IsQuasiSeparated (V : Set X.left)) :
   171	    IsPushout (X.hom.appLE ⊤ V (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge))
   172	      (T.hom.appLE ⊤ ⊤ (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge)
   173	      ((fst X T).left.appLE V ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V) le_rfl)
   174	      ((snd X T).left.appLE ⊤ ((fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V)
   175	        (le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top (snd X T).left).ge)) := by
   176	  have hUST : (⊤ : T.left.Opens) ≤ T.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   177	    (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top T.hom).ge
   178	  have hUSX : V ≤ X.hom ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : (Spec (.of k)).Opens) :=
   179	    le_top.trans (Scheme.Hom.preimage_top X.hom).ge
   180	  have hUY : (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V =
   181	      (fst X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ V ⊓ (snd X T).left ⁻¹ᵁ (⊤ : T.left.Opens) := by
   182	    rw [Scheme.Hom.preimage_top, inf_top_eq]
   183	  have h := isIso_pushoutSection_of_isQuasiSeparated_of_flat_right
   184	    (Over.isPullback_left X T) hUST hUSX hUY (isAffineOpen_top _) hT hV hV'
   185	  exact (isIso_pushoutSection_iff _ _ _ _).mp h
   186	
   187	end Pushout
   188	
   189	section TensorFace
   190	
   191	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (X : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   192	
   193	/-- The `k`-algebra structure on `Γ(X.left, V)` for `X` an object of `Over (Spec k)`:
   194	restriction of scalars along the structure morphism `X.hom`. Deliberately **not** a global
   195	instance (it would overlap with mathlib's `Algebra R Γ(Spec R, U)` instances; cf. the house
   196	rule for `Scheme.overModule`). Activate it locally with
   197	`attribute [local instance] Over.sectionsAlgebra` — the statements of this file mention it
   198	explicitly, so consumers must activate the same instance for the statements to elaborate
   199	identically. -/
   200	@[reducible] noncomputable def Over.sectionsAlgebra (V : X.left.Opens) :
   201	    Algebra k Γ(X.left, V) :=

/-!
# The category of sheaves of modules over a scheme

In this file, we define the abelian category of sheaves of modules
`X.Modules` over a scheme `X`, and study its basic functoriality.

-/

@[expose] public section

universe t u

open CategoryTheory Limits TopologicalSpace SheafOfModules Bicategory

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {X Y Z T : Scheme.{u}}

variable (X) in
/-- The category of sheaves of modules over a scheme. -/
def Modules := SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf

namespace Modules

/-- Morphisms between `𝒪ₓ`-modules. Use `Hom.app` to act on sections. -/
def Hom (M N : X.Modules) : Type u := SheafOfModules.Hom M N

instance : Category X.Modules where
  Hom := Modules.Hom
  __ := (inferInstance : Category (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf))

noncomputable instance : Abelian X.Modules :=
  inferInstanceAs <| Abelian (SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf)
instance : HasLimits X.Modules := inferInstanceAs (HasLimits (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))
instance : HasColimits X.Modules := inferInstanceAs (HasColimits (SheafOfModules X.ringCatSheaf))

section Functor

variable (X) in
/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of modules.
This is mostly useful to transport results from (pre)sheaves of modules to `𝒪ₓ`-modules and
usually shouldn't be used directly when working with actual `𝒪ₓ`-modules. -/
def toPresheafOfModules : X.Modules ⥤ X.PresheafOfModules := SheafOfModules.forget _

/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of modules is fully faithful. -/
def fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules : (Modules.toPresheafOfModules X).FullyFaithful :=
  SheafOfModules.fullyFaithfulForget _

instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).Full := fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules.full
instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).Faithful := fullyFaithfulToPresheafOfModules.faithful
instance : (toPresheafOfModules X).IsRightAdjoint :=
  (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction (𝟙 X.ringCatSheaf.obj)).isRightAdjoint

variable (X) in
/-- The forgetful functor from `𝒪ₓ`-modules to presheaves of abelian groups. -/
noncomputable def toPresheaf : X.Modules ⥤ TopCat.Presheaf Ab X :=
  toPresheafOfModules X ⋙ PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _

instance : (toPresheaf X).Faithful := .comp _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)
instance : PreservesLimits (toPresheaf X) := comp_preservesLimits _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)
instance : (toPresheaf X).ReflectsIsomorphisms :=
  reflectsIsomorphisms_comp _ (PresheafOfModules.toPresheaf _)

end Functor

section Presheaf

/-- The underlying abelian presheaf of an `𝒪ₓ`-module. -/
noncomputable def presheaf (M : X.Modules) : TopCat.Presheaf Ab X := M.1.presheaf

/-- Notation for sections of a presheaf of module. -/
scoped[AlgebraicGeometry] notation3 "Γ(" M ", " U ")" => (Scheme.Modules.presheaf M).obj (.op U)

instance : Module Γ(X, U) Γ(M, U) := (M.val.obj (.op U)).isModule

@[simp] lemma map_smul (i : U ⟶ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) (x : Γ(M, V)) :
    M.presheaf.map i.op (r • x) = X.presheaf.map i.op r • M.presheaf.map i.op x :=
  M.val.map_smul _ _ _

def smul : Γ(X, U) →+* End Γ(M, U) :=
  (M.val.obj (.op U)).smul

@[simp]
lemma smul_apply (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : (M.smul r).hom x = r • x := rfl

lemma map_comp_smul (i : U ⟶ V) (r : Γ(X, V)) :

/-- The application of a morphism of `𝒪ₓ`-modules to sections. -/
def Hom.app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U : X.Opens) : Γ(M, U) ⟶ Γ(N, U) :=
  (forget₂ _ _).map (φ.val.app (.op U))

@[simp] lemma mapPresheaf_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (U) : φ.mapPresheaf.app U = φ.app U.unop := rfl

@[simp]
lemma Hom.app_smul (φ : M ⟶ N) (r : Γ(X, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) :
    φ.app U (r • x) = r • φ.app U x :=
  (φ.val.app (.op U)).hom.map_smul r x

@[simp] lemma Hom.add_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : (φ + ψ).app U = φ.app U + ψ.app U := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.sub_app (φ ψ : M ⟶ N) : (φ - ψ).app U = φ.app U - ψ.app U := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.zero_app : (0 : M ⟶ N).app U = 0 := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.id_app (M : X.Modules) : (𝟙 M :).app U = 𝟙 _ := rfl
@[simp] lemma Hom.comp_app (φ : M ⟶ N) (ψ : N ⟶ K) : (φ ≫ ψ).app U = φ.app U ≫ ψ.app U := rfl

@[ext]
lemma hom_ext (f g : M ⟶ N) (H : ∀ U, f.app U = g.app U) : f = g := by
  apply SheafOfModules.hom_ext

  exact congr($(H U.unop) x)

lemma isSheaf (M : X.Modules) : M.presheaf.IsSheaf := SheafOfModules.isSheaf M

@[simp] lemma toPresheaf_obj : (toPresheaf X).obj M = M.presheaf := rfl
@[simp] lemma toPresheaf_map : (toPresheaf X).map φ = φ.mapPresheaf := rfl

import AlgebraicJacobian.Cohomology.ModuleKSheaf
import Mathlib.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.Sheaf

/-!
# Restricting a scheme module to the base ring

For a scheme `X` over `Spec k`, this file views an `X.Modules` object as a sheaf of
`k`-modules.  The construction keeps the same section types and restriction maps; only the
scalar action is restricted along `k -> Gamma(X, U)`.  It is the dialect bridge needed to
compare a `Scheme.Modules` line bundle with the fixed-base module sheaves used by the Cech
cohomology engine.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory TopologicalSpace Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme

variable {k : Type u} [CommRing k]

/-- The base-ring module structure on sections of a scheme module. -/
@[reducible] noncomputable def moduleKSections
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    (U : X.left.Opens) : Module k Γ(M, U) :=
  Module.compHom _ (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U)

attribute [local instance] moduleKSections

/-- The native structure-sheaf action, with section-notation binders kept explicit. -/
private noncomputable def smulSection
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (r : Γ(X.left, U)) (x : Γ(M, U)) : Γ(M, U) :=
  r • x

/-- The presheaf underlying a scheme module after restriction of scalars to the base ring. -/
noncomputable def toModuleKPresheafOfModules
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    X.left.Opensᵒᵖ ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k where
  obj U := ModuleCat.of k Γ(M, U.unop)
  map {U V} f := ModuleCat.ofHom
    { toFun := fun x => M.presheaf.map f x
      map_add' := fun x y => map_add _ x y
      map_smul' := fun r x =>
        (Scheme.Modules.map_smul M f.unop (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U.unop r) x).trans
          (congrArg
            (fun (s : Γ(X.left, V.unop)) =>
              smulSection X M V.unop s (M.presheaf.map f x))
            (X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k f r)) }
  map_id U := by
    ext x
    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (f : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj U) =>
      (ConcreteCategory.hom f : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_id U)) x
  map_comp {U V W} f g := by
    ext x
    exact congrFun (congrArg (fun (h : M.presheaf.obj U ⟶ M.presheaf.obj W) =>
      (ConcreteCategory.hom h : _ → _)) (M.presheaf.map_comp f g)) x

/-- The restricted presheaf is a sheaf because its underlying additive presheaf is unchanged. -/
lemma toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat)
      (toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M) := by
  rw [Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _ (CategoryTheory.forget (ModuleCat.{u} k))]
  convert (Presheaf.isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_forget _ _
      (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u})).mp (Scheme.Modules.isSheaf M) using 1 <;> rfl

/-- A sheaf of `O_X`-modules, viewed as a sheaf of modules over the base ring. -/
noncomputable def toModuleKSheafOfModules
    (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) (M : X.left.Modules) :
    Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X.left.toTopCat) (ModuleCat.{u} k) :=
  ⟨toModuleKPresheafOfModules X M, toModuleKPresheafOfModules_isSheaf X M⟩

/-- Restriction maps of the base-ring sheaf are definitionally those of the scheme module. -/
lemma toModuleKSheafOfModules_obj_map_apply
    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} (M : X.left.Modules)
    {V W : X.left.Opens} (h : W ≤ V)
    (x : (toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.obj (op V)) :
    ((toModuleKSheafOfModules X M).obj.map (homOfLE h).op).hom x =
      M.presheaf.map (homOfLE h).op x :=
  rfl

namespace Modules

variable {X : Scheme.{u}}

/-- A scheme module which is locally isomorphic to the structure sheaf. -/
def IsLineBundle (M : X.Modules) : Prop :=
  ∀ x : X, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧
    Nonempty ((restrictFunctor U.ι).obj M ≅ SheafOfModules.unit U.toScheme.ringCatSheaf)

end Modules

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme
